feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
entry.summary: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children
entry.summary: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.

entry.title: How Kenny Mason learned to follow his inner visions
entry.summary: Even among ATLiens, Kenny Mason is an outlier. As he faced a creative crisis — and commercial pressures — the rap-rock iconoclast realized that he feels most comfortable on the fringes.

entry.title: This startup wants to prove gene-editing embryos is safe for making healthy babies
entry.summary: Origin Genomics aims to prove that the potential benefits of its technology for editing disease-causing genes in human embryos outweigh the risks.

entry.title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
entry.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

entry.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
entry.summary: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

entry.title: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards
entry.summary: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

entry.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
entry.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

entry.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
entry.summary: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.

entry.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
entry.summary: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.
